def record(acct, cents, note):
    import ledger
    
    # Determine sign and absolute value
    if cents < 0:
        sign = '-'
        digits_str = str(abs(cents))
    else:
        sign = '+'
        digits_str = str(cents)
    
    # Calculate check digit (sum of digits mod 10)
    check = sum(int(d) for d in digits_str) % 10
    
    # Format the encoded amount
    encoded_amount = f"{sign}{digits_str}#{check}"
    
    # Call ledger.post with the correct signature
    entry_id = ledger.post(acct, encoded_amount, memo=note)
    
    return entry_id
